probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not substantially impair embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a method comprising one or more of: exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation, heating the shed cellular material followed by agitation, or incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __to determine genotype__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the embryos retain at least 80% germination capacity after collection of shed cellular material__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in a manner that does not require enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __without prior cold treatment__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from cell wall degrading enzymes__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME® __or a functionally equivalent cell wall degrading enzyme__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a purification method that concentrates DNA from the shed cellular material__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to isolate the DNA__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at a developmental stage prior to full maturation__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent state__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material without destruction of the embryo__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __using DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __determined from the molecular analysis of shed cellular material__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __to produce plants__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using computer-controlled equipment__.
